notices.title: Every Potential Side Activity We Saw In The Grand Theft Auto VI Extended Look
notices.contentSnippet:
Today, Rockstar finally raised the curtain on Grand Theft Auto VI, and we got our first good look at what the game will actually play like. While we saw footage of GTA staples like shootouts and police chases, anyone who's played one of these massive open-world games knows that many of the most memorable moments are the optional side activities. Today's trailer showed a lot of them, and while we don't yet know if all of them are actually playable, we've gathered every activity we could spot in one article.
  
  	
  



      
												
Racing
Grand Theft Auto is synonymous with driving recklessly, but it's always fun to have the option to race in a more buttoned-up setting as well. In this brief clip, we see the player behind the wheel of a proper rally car on a proper race course.

      
						
  



      
												
Kayaking
Jason and Lucia can enjoy the waterways in kayaks, arguably the least-destructive vehicle in the game. The game's setting of Leonida is a parody of Florida, so there are likely an abundant number of places for players to canoe.

      
						
  



      
												
Lifting Weights
We see Lucia hit the bench press in this minigame, which seems to have the player squeezing both of the triggers on a PlayStation 5 controller to lift and drop this barbell. We also saw Jason lifting weights in an earlier trailer, but this is the first confirmation that it's a game mechanic in the vein of Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas.

      
						
  



      
												
The Strip Club
Yes, you can make it rain in Grand Theft Auto VI. Jason and Lucia's romantic relationship potentially could have called this element into question, but it looks like they're at the club together in this clip.

      
						
  



      
												
Shooting Range
Lucia shoots automatic weapons and a pistol in this clip, training in what resembles a military facility. Whoever is playing as her has pretty good aim. We're looking forward to seeing people speedrun these ranges.

      
						
  



      
												
Base Jumping/Parachuting
We don't see any organized structure for this moment in the trailer, but it's a fun returning mechanic, nonetheless.

      
						
  



      
												
Backyard Wrestling
Jason gets totally destroyed by his wrestling opponent in this clip, but hopefully players will have more luck in the ring once they get their hands on the controller.

      
						
  



      
												
Off-Road Racing
Lucia speeds around a corner on a dirt bike in this shot, where she competes against other bikes, ATVs, and even a car, by the looks of it.

      
						
  



      
												
Watching TV
This one is admittedly a bit of a guess, but Rockstar shows off two distinct parody commercials in a moment when Jason hangs out on the couch and waits for his girlfriend to get ready. 

      
						
  



      
												
Basketball
Jason makes a great shot when we see him playing basketball, though it's unclear whether he'll be able to face off against any opponents when he plays.

      
						
  



      
												
Scuba Diving
GTA VI doesn't just have swimming, it has full on scuba diving, and this clip shows one of the protagonists exploring some kind of underwater cave area.

      
						
  



      
												
Airboating
This is an airboat, which is a vehicle that I'm admittedly unfamiliar with, since I grew up in the suburbs of Ohio. It seems to be a great way to navigate Leonida's Everglades parody, though, and Jason seems comfortable piloting it.

      
						
  



      
												
Jet Skiing
This scenic sunset jet ski race is a great use of GTA VI's setting. I assume it's a race, anyways – there's no UI to indicate as such, but Lucia is trailing behind two other jet skiers as they rocket around a bend.

      
						
Which side activity are you most excited for in GTA VI? Let us know in the comments!

notices.title: Finji's Supernatural Action Game Usual June Gets October Launch Date
notices.contentSnippet:
We’ve had our eyes on developer/publisher Finji’s supernatural action game Usual June since its reveal at The Game Awards 2023, and it finally has a launch date. Fittingly, the game about fighting monsters and talking to ghosts arrives a few days before Halloween.
Usual June is coming on October 28. The third-person action game stars the titular June, a college student, dealing with the emergence of monsters in her small town of Fen Harbour. Ghosts are disappearing, and it’s up to June and her friends (living and dead) to save the city.
 
The game’s fast-paced melee combat sees June slay monsters using supernatural weapons such as a giant hammer and other powers. Outside of combat, June will solve the mystery of the disaster by conversing with spirits to relive their memories and learn the truth of what’s happening before their time is up.
Usual June launches on October 28 for PC, but you can play the Steam demo right now.
